{{Quote|Look, I'm a bit preoccupied at the moment. Perhaps at some point in the future I'll have need of your assistance, but I can't think about that right now.|Arrek Von Sarko|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Arrek Von Sarko''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he would frequent the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="AED" />

==Biography==
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] by the name of Arrek Von Sarko frequented the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. While there, he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], and tasked the individual with completing a number of tasks. The first involved delivering a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] containing a compendium of evidence in an ongoing fraud investigation into [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] shipping interests of [[Shalera]] the [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to an individual named [[Huffee Vindaag]]. Despite being ambushed by a [[tusk cat]] on the way to Vindaag in the Naboo countryside, the spacer succeeded in delivering the datadisc.<ref name="AED" />

Von Sarko's next task was to escort an [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] named [[Folux Pozur]] back to Moenia. The spacer succeeded, despite being ambushed by yet another dangerous beast called a [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]]. However, the spacer's work did not end there. Von Sarko also requested that an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] named [[Merox Suld]] be escorted back to the city. Although the spacer was attacked by a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] attempting to impede the sergeant's rescue, the spacer neutralized the native and brought the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] back to the safe confines of Moenia.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arrek Von Sarko was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Players who performed a series of quests for Von Sarko had to deliver a datadisc to Vindaag, and escort Pozur and Sergeant Suld safely back to Moenia. Although these three quests could be completed, Von Sarko's dialogue was incomplete, thus providing limited context for the quest's storyline.<ref name="AED" /> The game files suggest that Von Sarko paid 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as a reward for each of the three questions, in addition to a [[Bracelet/Legends|bracelet]] as a reward for the second quest.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> However, it is not known if these rewards were actually implemented. Von Sarko's quests were removed at some point during the game's lifespan, but he remained in the Moenia cantina. If a player were to attempt to converse with him, he would simply dismiss the player by saying, "I'm a bit preoccupied at the moment."<ref name="AED" />
